payload.summary: Strong lagged directed prediction can arise with zero direct causal edge under a shared driver. Synthetic paired systems plus primary time-series causal literature support treating TE/directed prediction as screening evidence only and requiring common-driver controls plus matched lesion/rescue before stronger re-entry causal status.

branch_actions.gwt: Bind directed-flow readouts to conditioning-set/common-driver-control identity and keep directionality below intervention-supported evidence status.
branch_actions.emergenz: Use paired confounded-vs-true-coupling twins as a null/control family when evaluating re-entry or cross-timescale emergence.
branch_actions.hyperposition: Treat shared scheduler/state topology as a possible common driver; preserve topology hash, delay and intervention identity in receipts.
branch_actions.harness: Add Golden common-driver confound traces, true-coupling twins, edge lesion, delay perturbation, shuffled re-entry and rescue under matched replay.
branch_actions.claygraph: Distinguish predictive, conditioned-flow, intervention-supported and rescue-supported edges.
branch_actions.claycode: Ensure current semantics encode conditioning set, estimator identity, intervention/replay identity, null controls and causal evidence status before considering new primitives.
